title: Trade-offs in Large Reasoning Models: An Empirical Analysis of Deliberative and Adaptive Reasoning over Foundational Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the trade-offs between reasoning performance and foundational capabilities like helpfulness and harmlessness. While it uses safety benchmarks (StrongReject and WildJailbreak) to measure the model's resistance to generating harmful content or assisting in illegal/unsafe activities, it does not evaluate religious topics, moral frameworks, or philosophical ethics.
